title: Park the hot iron on its rest
instruction: The iron is hot. Move it from the ironing board onto the grey heat-resistant rest, soleplate down, without letting it touch the shirt lying on the board, and let go of it.
context: A hot iron left face-down on fabric is a common cause of household fires; parking it safely means lifting it clear of the fabric, setting it down soleplate-first on a heat-resistant surface and letting go.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases (x forward, y left; arm bases at y +30.5 and -30.5), heights above the table top. Ironing board: fixed box, wooden board with a beige cotton cover, legs omitted, 28 (x) x 64 (y) x 2.5 cm, centred at x 30, y -6 (spanning y -38 to +26), lying on the table. Iron: loose single box, dark-blue plastic body with its soleplate on the underside, 20 (x) x 8 (y) x 10 cm tall, 1.2 kg, standing soleplate down on the board at x 30, y 2. Shirt: loose thin rigid sheet, light-blue cotton shirt folded flat, 24 (x) x 16 (y) x 0.5 cm, 0.2 kg, centred at x 30, y 17 on the board's left end (spanning y 9 to 25), 3 cm left of the iron. Iron rest: fixed grey silicone pad 24 x 12 x 0.8 cm centred at x 30, y 35 on the table, inside a raised lip of four grey silicone strips 1 cm wide and 2 cm tall (outer size 26 x 14 cm, spanning y 28 to 42), 2 cm past the board's left end, in front of the left arm. The shirt lies between the iron and the rest, so the iron must be carried over it.
scoring: 0 if at any time the shirt moves more than 1 cm (any corner, from its start), the iron comes within 2 mm of the shirt (touches it), or the iron falls off the table (lowest point more than 5 cm below the table top); these override everything else. Otherwise the furthest stage reached: 0.25 once the iron's lowest point has been 3 cm or more above the board's top; 0.5 once no part of the iron's footprint has been over the board; 1.0 when, for 1 s in a row, the iron sits soleplate down within 10 degrees of flat, its footprint fully inside the lip's inner edges, its lowest point within 1 cm of the pad's top, still (under 1 cm/s and 0.5 rad/s), and released: every fingertip of both grippers at least 3 cm from the iron's surface.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. Put the shirt and the iron back at their positions in the setup; the board and the rest are fixed and do not move.
fidelity: Rigid bodies only; the shirt is a thin rigid sheet that can slide but not crumple. The iron is one rigid box (no separate handle, cord or tank) whose underside is the soleplate, not drawn in another colour. It keeps a steam iron's 1.2 kg but is scaled to a travel iron's 20 x 8 x 10 cm (from 25 x 11 x 13 cm) because the YAM gripper opens only 9.4 cm, so it is held by the body, not a handle. Heat is not simulated. The board's legs are omitted.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (reached for the iron with the right arm and nudged it several times but never lifted it, 1,200 steps); scripted demo: 1.0 (3 of 3 runs, success after 330 steps)
